How to read this report

  • The farm is split into small square grid cells. Each value is the average of the satellite and weather data inside that cell.
  • Each score runs from 0 to 1. Higher is better.
  • Colour bands: Good 0.70 or more   Fair 0.40 to 0.70   Needs attention below 0.40. These bands are a reading aid used by this app, not an official standard.
  • A dash (—) means there was no data for that value.
